preview.tournamentOverview: Detroit Golf Club is a classic parkland layout that rewards ball-striking and precision over raw distance. The course places a premium on approach play and off-the-tee accuracy, with less emphasis on putting.
preview.modelExplainer: Our model weights SG Off-the-Tee at 8% and SG Approach at 3%, making ball-striking the dominant factor this week. SG Total carries 8% weight, while SG Around-the-Green and SG Putting are down-weighted at 6% and 4%, respectively. Driving accuracy and bogey avoidance each contribute 1% and 0%, reflecting the course's emphasis on avoiding trouble and maintaining scoring opportunities.
preview.pickApproach: We prioritize players who rank highly in SG OTT and SG APP, as these categories carry the heaviest course weights. This tiered approach ensures we target players with the strongest profiles for success at Detroit Golf Club.

article.title: Rocket Classic 2026: Model Ranks Young, Kim, Knapp Highest at Detroit
article.dek: Cameron Young leads the field in the tournament model at 574 SG total; Si Woo Kim and Jake Knapp follow at 236 and 002 respectively.
article.introduction: The Rocket Classic at Detroit Golf Club opens July 30 with a 147-player field. The model weights off-the-tee 8%) and approach 3%) most heavily, and the top three model ranks align with those categories. Cameron Young, Si Woo Kim, and Jake Knapp occupy the first three spots in the tournament model.

sections.heading: Tournament Overview
sections.body: Detroit Golf Club places the largest weight on SG OTT 8%) and SG APP 3%). The model ranks Cameron Young first 574 SG total), Si Woo Kim second 236), and Jake Knapp third 002).

sections.heading: Course Fit
sections.body: Young leads the model with 699 SG OTT and 499 SG APP. Kim posts the strongest approach number among the three at 912 SG APP. Knapp's 285 SG putting is the highest of the group.

sections.heading: Recent Form
sections.body: Young enters with a top-five finish at The Open. Kim posted a top-ten at The Open. Knapp missed the cut at The Open but ranks third in both model and power rank.

sections.heading: Post-Open Workload
sections.body: Young logged four tracked rounds after The Open. Kim also logged four tracked rounds. Knapp logged two tracked rounds.

sections.heading: FedExCup Motivation
sections.body: Young sits third in the FedExCup standings. Kim is seventh. Knapp is 38th; all three are inside the top 50.

sections.heading: Crossover Research Angles
sections.body: Young and Kim both skipped the Scottish Open and rank inside the top ten of the tournament model. Knapp also skipped the Scottish Open and carries the third-strongest model rank.

sections.heading: Outright Targets
sections.body: Cameron Young (model rank 1, 574 SG total) and Si Woo Kim (model rank 2, 236 SG total) are the two outright targets. Both carry top-10 model ranks and skipped the Scottish Open.

sections.heading: Top-10 Targets
sections.body: Cameron Young, Si Woo Kim, and Jake Knapp (model rank 3, 002 SG total) form the top-10 card. Knapp's SG total leads the trio, while Young and Kim add model rank separation from their power ranks.

sections.heading: Top-20 Targets
sections.body: The same three players—Young, Kim, and Knapp—anchor the top-20 card. Each player's model rank sits inside the top three and is supported by at least one SG category above 499.

sections.heading: Data Limitations
sections.body: Weather and tee-time data are unavailable. Workload coverage includes only recorded rounds from The Open Championship and Genesis Scottish Open; opposite-field, DP World Tour, LIV, and other events may be missing.

sections.heading: Final Betting Card
sections.body: Tier 1 (model-supported): Cameron Young, Si Woo Kim. Tier 2 (model-supported): Jake Knapp.

article.conclusion: Tier-1 model targets: Cameron Young and Si Woo Kim. Tier-2 model target: Jake Knapp. All three are top-20 plays; no additional names are added.
